name: qr-scanner
title: QR Scanner
description: Scan QR codes with your camera, from your screens, or from a clipboard image
author: genm

commands.name: scan-camera
commands.title: Scan QR from Camera
commands.description: Open a camera preview and scan a QR code

commands.name: scan-screen
commands.title: Scan QR from Screen
commands.description: Find QR codes visible on any connected display

commands.name: scan-clipboard
commands.title: Scan QR from Clipboard
commands.description: Find QR codes in copied images

scripts.check: npm run check:toolchain && npm run check:error-contract && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:swift && npm run build && npm run audit:dependencies
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "\"Error: cannot publish this package directly to npm\"" && exit 1
scripts.test:swift: mkdir -p test-results && swift test --package-path swift/ScannerKit --parallel --xunit-output test-results/swift.xml && swift test --package-path cli --parallel --xunit-output test-results/swift-cli.xml
